(ii) Which row has 60 seats? [1]
(iii) Find the total number of seats in the auditorium. [2]

(i) How far does he run on the 8th day? [1]

(iii) What is the total distance he runs in the first 15 days? [2]

(i) What is the common difference of the AP formed by the prize amounts? [1]

(iii) Find the total prize money for the 7 prizes. [2]
OR
(iii) If the school had given 9 prizes in the same way, what would the total prize money be? [2]
